people.name: Queen_of_Sheba
people.line: A queen who visited Solomon and praised his wisdom

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
translations.bsb: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired—whatever she asked—besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants.
translations.kjv: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
translations.asv: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, besides that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.
